answer: A network could require Signed union membership with dues history before the first reward. Since dues paid to a union month after month, the lotus is that fakes arrive expensive and honest agents arrive free. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since dues paid to a union month after month takes calendar time as well as money — and the canyon is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the juniper cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
